entities.summary: Nicola Ferguson Sturgeon is a Scottish politician who served as First Minister of Scotland and Leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP) from 2014 to 2023. She has served as a member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) from 1999, firstly as an additional member for the Glasgow electoral region, and then as the member for Glasgow Southside from 2007.
